#summary Downloads and Update Site of the EMFStore

This site contains releases and nightly builds of the EMFStore. Currently there are only nightly builds.

==Nightly builds==

The EMFStore features can be installed from this update site:

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/updatesite/emfstoreNightly http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/updatesite/emfstoreNightly]

You can also download a standalone version as a product from the links given below.

  * [http://www1.in.tum.de/static/shared/unicase/products/0.4.3.nightly/0.4.3.nightly_linux.gtk.x86.zip 0.4.3.nightly for Linux gtk x86]
  * [http://www1.in.tum.de/static/shared/unicase/products/0.4.3.nightly/0.4.3.nightly_macosx.carbon.x86.zip 0.4.3.nightly for MacOsX carbon x86]
  * [http://www1.in.tum.de/static/shared/unicase/products/0.4.3.nightly/0.4.3.nightly_macosx.cocoa.x86_64.zip 0.4.3.nightly for MacOsX cocoa x86 and 64bit]
  * [http://www1.in.tum.de/static/shared/unicase/products/0.4.3.nightly/0.4.3.nightly_macosx.cocoa.x86.zip 0.4.3.nightly for MacOsX cocoa x86]
  * [http://www1.in.tum.de/static/shared/unicase/products/0.4.3.nightly/0.4.3.nightly_win32.x86_64.zip 0.4.3.nightly for Windows x86 and 64bit]
